BEFORE · PROSPECTBOX 1
1. My Target Market
Dr. Siti Represents: University & polytechnic lecturers, STEM teachers, technical trainers, lab managers, FYP supervisors, institutional purchasers.
Subjects Taught: Basic programming, digital I/O, GPIO control, sensors, serial comms, Wi-Fi/BLE, IoT, robotics, automation, academic projects.
What She Currently Does: Prepares slides/labs, checks board drivers, demonstrates code, prepares external components, checks student wiring, evaluates hardware.
Main Concerns: Board variations between students, driver confusion, loose wiring, students copying code without understanding, losing time troubleshooting basic setup.
Survey Proof: ESP32 Telegram poll shows educators at 21% (3/14); Sumo poll shows 12% (2/17); STEM poll shows 14%. (High multiplication impact).
BEFORE · PROSPECTBOX 2
2. My Message to My Target Market
Make ESP32 Learning More Visible and Easier to Demonstrate

Maker ESP32 gives Dr. Siti a familiar ESP32 platform with onboard indicators, built-in input and output tools, and structured Cytron-supported resources.

  • Prepare Faster: USB-C, NodeMCU form factor, built-in button & buzzer, 14 GPIO LEDs, Cytron docs.
  • Teach Clearly: 14 GPIO activity LEDs, RX/TX LEDs, button, buzzer, mute switch, immediate feedback.
  • Progress Further: 8MB flash, 520KB SRAM, Wi-Fi/BLE, Maker Port (Qwiic/STEMMA QT/Grove).
Compliance: Powered by an ESP32-WROOM-32E module type-approved by SIRIM under Cytron. (Approval applies to module; designed to make classroom setup & beginner experiments easier).
Emotional Trigger: "More class time teaching concepts, less time fixing setup errors."
